acceptance_criteria: wired is added to the module-level __all__ list
tasks.objective: Add a pure wired(report) -> GateResult gate function to the existing module overseer/gates.py, exported via __all__, that fails closed when a wire report shows no live importers (an orphan) and passes otherwise.

spec.objective: Add a pure wired(report) -> GateResult gate function to the existing module overseer/gates.py, exported via __all__, that fails closed when a wire report shows no live importers (an orphan) and passes otherwise.
functional_requirements: Define a new module-level function wired(report) that returns a GateResult.
GateResult is the existing dataclass in this module with fields ok: bool, reason: str, fix_hint: str.
When report is a mapping whose 'live_importers' value is a non-empty sequence, return GateResult(ok=True, reason='', fix_hint='').

When report's 'live_importers' is empty OR the 'live_importers' key is absent, return GateResult(ok=False, ...) with a reason naming the orphan and an actionable fix_hint about adding a live importer.
Add the string 'wired' to the module-level __all__ list so it is exported alongside the existing gate functions.
spec.interfaces: wired(report) -> GateResult, where GateResult(ok: bool, reason: str, fix_hint: str) is the existing dataclass already defined in overseer/gates.py.
edge_cases: report missing the 'live_importers' key entirely must fail closed (ok=False), not raise and not pass.
report with an empty live_importers list is an orphan -> ok=False.
non_goals: No integration wiring into gate_runner, procedure.py, or the orchestrator -- this leaf adds the pure gate function only; that is a separate leaf.
No changes to the existing GateResult dataclass or the other gate functions; preserve all existing behaviour and the existing __all__ entries.
No process/network/model call; pure function over its report argument.
spec.implementation_notes: EDIT the EXISTING module overseer/gates.py to ADD one new top-level function `wired` and to add 'wired' to the existing module-level __all__ list. CRITICAL PATCH SHAPE (a new top-level symbol emitted as its OWN patch entry FAILS to apply -- you MUST R-ANCHOR it): emit EXACTLY TWO symbol patch entries, each anchored on an EXISTING symbol: (1) anchor = the existing function `posture_locked`: its patch `code` must contain the COMPLETE existing posture_locked function UNCHANGED, followed immediately by the NEW `wired` function as a trailing top-level def (this rides the new symbol in on an existing anchor). (2) anchor = the existing module-level `__all__` assignment: its patch `code` must be the full __all__ list literal reproduced with the new string 'wired' appended (e.g. __all__ = ['GateResult', 'oracle_is_red', 'oracles_committed_at_head', 'brief_lint', 'plan_preflight', 'suite_green_zero_reg', 'posture_locked', 'wired']). Do NOT emit `wired` as its own separate patch entry. Do NOT use any default-argument or import-time side-effect trick to mutate __all__ -- update the __all__ literal directly via entry (2). The module defines a @dataclass GateResult with fields ok: bool, reason: str, fix_hint: str. The wired body: if isinstance(report, Mapping) and report.get('live_importers') is a non-empty sequence -> return GateResult(ok=True, reason='', fix_hint=''); otherwise (empty list OR missing key) -> return GateResult(ok=False, reason='orphan: the module has no live importer', fix_hint='Add an import/call from a live module so the new module is reachable from a live entrypoint.'). Mapping is already imported in this module. Do NOT modify posture_locked's behaviour, the GateResult dataclass, or any other function. Do NOT cite line numbers. The committed oracle below is authoritative -- your code MUST make it pass.
